facts.text: Cedric's signed promissory note obliges him to pay the party 975 gold for the treasure, three-quarters price, once the caravans flow again. It cannot be collected until then.
facts.uncertain_reason: The note was used to recruit Malzazarik and Lady Hilda (beat_62); it is unclear whether the party still holds it or has pledged its proceeds.

facts.text: The party owes Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment out of Cedric's promissory note for joining the party. The debt is settled when the note's 975 gold is paid over or handed to them.
facts.uncertain_reason: The exact terms of the recruitment are not stated (beat_62), including whether the note itself was handed over.
